tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the Agent Index open dataset of GRC, security, and operations AI agents. Returns canonical theagentindex.io URLs. Not a ranking.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get one Agent Index listing by slug, with the canonical page URL and source citations.

tools.name: search_auditors
tools.description: Search compliance audit firms in Agent Index (Verified and registry-listed), labelled by listing tier. Cross-checked against official accreditation registries (ANAB, UKAS, NABCB, PCI SSC, HITRUST, FedRAMP, GovRAMP, Cyber AB, CERT-In, ISMAP, CPAverify). Not a ranking or endorsement.

tools.name: get_auditor
tools.description: Get one audit firm by slug, including listing_tier, the Verified flag, and accreditation registry URLs for official cross-checks.

tools.name: compare_agents
tools.description: Compare 2–4 Agent Index listings side by side. Facts only — not a ranking or recommendation.
